integrated_multimodal_description
A young woman in a flowing white traditional Hanfu robe stands against a clear blue sky. She extends her right hand toward a fluffy white cloud on the left, her fingers slightly curled as if gently holding or feeling the cloud. Her long dark hair and the wide sleeves of her robe flutter dynamically in a soft breeze. The camera starts with a medium shot and slowly pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening the frame on her serene expression and outstretched hand. The lighting is bright, natural sunlight coming from the upper right, creating a soft rim light on her hair and shoulders. As the camera pushes in, the cloud seems to shift slightly closer to her fingertips. The scene cuts to a close-up of her face and hand; she blinks slowly, and a gentle smile appears on her lips, while the wind continues to blow her hair strands. The camera holds steady on this intimate frame for the remainder of the duration.
overall_soundscape
A soft, natural breeze sound flows continuously throughout the video. Faint, ethereal whooshing sounds occur as the fabric of the Hanfu sleeves flutters in the wind. There is a subtle, delicate sound of hair moving against the skin.
non_diegetic_music
A soft, ambient instrumental track featuring a solo Chinese guzheng and a faint string pad. The tempo is slow and flowing, with gentle, sustained notes that rise and fall like the wind, creating a peaceful and airy atmosphere.
